_doc: A rowboat of your own on the street map's water (player/rowboats.js rules, ui/innerMapRowboat.js on the map). Bought from the boatwright of a town whose map has water (price: into that town's purse, PlayerCoin.pay; sold back out of it at sellBack of the price, what the purse holds), or built on a bank from what is in your packs (build.ingredients, build.hours on the clock). It stays where you tie it up: player.rowboats [{ id, name, hq, hr, q, r }] by world hex and street-map cell. Aboard you row over water at rowSpeed of a walk (dry, not swimming); a river's current carries you when you stop rowing (unless tied up), on into the next hex at the river's edge. max: boats owned at once.
